lore: Above every reef where the shoals keep their saves floats a buoy strung with little bells. Ring a save's name at the buoy and listen: if any of its bells stays silent, the save was never sunk there and nobody needs to dive. If every bell rings, it might be down there. Too few bells and they ring for everything; too many and the string is so crowded they ring for everything too.

lines.start: Six reefs, six buoys, ten bells' worth of string per save. Let's see who needs to get wet today.
lines.ask: Ring the name and listen. One silent bell and you can stay dry.
lines.dive: Every bell rang. Might be down there, might not. Over the side you go.
lines.win: Hardly a wasted dive all season, and never once did a buoy lie about a save that was there.
lines.fail: The divers are worn out chasing saves that were never sunk. Restring those bells.
